# AI models compared: cost vs quality across eight model makers

> What the current models of Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu (GLM) and Moonshot (Kimi) cost at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

## [AI models compared: cost vs quality across eight model makers](https://models.agensse.com/)

Best value overall: GPT-6.1 Terra at xHigh effort, 3.7× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 69.6 % on the benchmark panel, cost 34× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → GPT-6 Luna with thinking off; everyday tasks → GPT-6 Luna at medium effort; advanced reasoning → Gemini 4 Carbon at medium effort (promo until 30 Nov); cutting-edge thinking → Gemini 4 Carbon at high effort (promo until 30 Nov). Highest measured quality: Claude Fable 5.2 at max effort (expected score 76.5 %, cost 1251× the cheapest couple).

From 458 sources · 2540 benchmarks · 22631 measurements. Updated 2026-11-19.

## [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://models.agensse.com/claude/)

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at high effort, 2.0× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 59.3 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.8× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at medium effort; advanced reasoning → Fable 5.2 at high effort; cutting-edge thinking → Fable 5.2 at max effort. Highest measured quality: Fable 5.2 at max effort (expected score 76.5 %, cost 438× the cheapest couple).

From 356 sources · 1724 benchmarks · 7845 measurements. Updated 2026-11-19.

## [OpenAI models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://models.agensse.com/openai/)

Best pick by task tier: grunt work → GPT-6 Luna at medium effort; everyday tasks → GPT-6 Luna at medium effort; advanced reasoning → GPT-6.1 Terra at xHigh effort; cutting-edge thinking → GPT-6.1 Sol at max effort. Highest measured quality: GPT-6 Astra at max effort (expected score 72.6 %, cost 358× the cheapest couple).

From 301 sources · 1514 benchmarks · 8099 measurements. Updated 2026-11-19.

## [Google models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://models.agensse.com/google/)

Best value overall: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at minimal effort, 2.6× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 43.4 % on the benchmark panel, cost 1.0× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at minimal effort; everyday tasks → Gemini 4 Hydrogen at low effort; advanced reasoning → Gemini 4 Argon at low effort (promo until 30 Nov); cutting-edge thinking → Gemini 4 Carbon at high effort (promo until 30 Nov). Highest measured quality: Gemini 4 Carbon at high effort (promo until 30 Nov) (expected score 75.3 %, cost 81× the cheapest couple).

From 181 sources · 929 benchmarks · 2814 measurements. Updated 2026-11-19.

## [Kimi models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://models.agensse.com/kimi/)

Best value overall: Kimi K2.7 Code, 1.1× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 54.9 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.9× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Kimi K2.6 with thinking off; everyday tasks → Kimi K2.7 Code; advanced reasoning → Kimi K3 at max effort; cutting-edge thinking → Kimi K3 at max effort. Highest measured quality: Kimi K3 at max effort (expected score 62.1 %, cost 9.6× the cheapest couple).

From 87 sources · 444 benchmarks · 576 measurements. Updated 2026-11-19.

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple shown on each page; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md and docs/DISPLAY-METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository (https://github.com/alexandregensse-blip/claude-models-value-analysis). Data: raw-data.csv, CC BY 4.0.
